title: POST /api/v1/feed/heartbeats request
description: A machine's whole list of heartbeats now, replacing what was stored for it: a heartbeat left out is gone (an empty list clears them). Sent only once a `sessions-stored` answer `accepts` `heartbeats`, while the machine's daemon runs heartbeats: when the list changes and every 10 minutes meanwhile. `at` is the machine's clock (Unix ms).
